question: Only the ________ can make the proclamation of emergency in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**President.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **proclamation of emergency in India** can only be made by the** President of India,** who is the **head of state** and the** commander-in-chief **of the **armed forces.**
 
• The **Constitution of India** provides for** three types** of emergencies:** national** emergency, **state **emergency, and** financial **emergency.
 
• In case of a **national emergency, **the** President** can declare emergency on the grounds of** war, external aggression, or armed rebellion**.
 
• The decision to impose emergency must be approved by the **Union Cabinet** and ratified by **both houses of Parliament.**
 
• The **Governor of a state** can declare **state emergency** in case of **failure of constitutional machinery **in the state, but only on the advice of the **Council of Ministers** headed by the **Chief Minister.**
 
• The **Chief Minister** is the head of the **Council of Ministers** in a state and is responsible for the **administration of the state.**
 
• However, the Chief Minister does not have the** power to proclaim emergency **in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Governor of a state** is appointed by the** President **and is the** constitutional head of the state,** but acts on the **advice of the Council of Ministers **headed by the **Chief Minister**.
 
• The **Chief Minister **is appointed by the** Governor **and is the leader of the** ruling party or coalition **in the state legislature.
 
 
• The Chief Minister is responsible for the** day-to-day administration** of the state and for** implementing the policies **of the state government.
 
 
 
• The **Prime Minister** is the head of the **Union Council of Ministers** and is responsible for the** overall administration** of the country.
 
 
• However, the Prime Minister** does not have** the power to** proclaim emergency **in India.
 
 
 
• The **President of India** is elected by an** electoral college **consisting of the **elected members **of both **houses of Parliament **and the **elected members of the Legislative Assemblies **of the states.
 
 
• The President is the** head of state** and represents the **unity of the nation.**
